steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Moc Loc, a wood element deer with leaf antlers, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: gracefully lowering its neck toward the food on the floor; (3) EAT: nibbling delicately with tiny bites; (4) EAT: chewing slowly, ears twitching. Row 2: (5) EAT: licking its nose, tail flicking happily; (6) PLAY: play bow, front legs down, rump up; (7) PLAY: springing straight up stiff-legged (pronking); (8) PLAY: high in the air, all four legs tucked, leaf antlers glowing. Row 3: (9) PLAY: a graceful sideways leap, body twisting; (10) PLAY: landing lightly on the tips of its hooves; (11) PLAY: rearing up on its hind legs happily; (12) REFUSE food: lifting its head high and turning its nose away. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eyes closed, nuzzling upward, ears relaxed; (14) WAVE hello: lifting one front hoof to say hello; (15) SAD: lying folded with its head down, ears drooping; (16) ANGRY: stamping a hoof and lowering its antlers.
